thesis: The speakers argue that the old media playbook is obsolete because attention is now the scarce resource, requiring organizations to adopt new media thinking where being interesting matters more than being inoffensive. They contend that in this new environment, speed and authenticity have replaced caution, allowing organizations to flood the zone with interesting content to quickly erase negative narratives rather than defending against leaks in a limited number of traditional channels.
